There is no index on :topic_id (or :post_id), so any queries filtering by topic_id (as in spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb: `TopicEmbed.where(topic_id: post.topic_id)`) would require a full table scan as topic_embeds grows. This is a performance/schema design concern rather than a functional bug, and the diff doesn’t show production code relying on topic_id lookups heavily (most lookups use embed_url).
